title: The mental toll of working in tech
why_read: A personal essay on burnout and impostor syndrome in tech careers offers emotional relatability but no technical substance.
analysis: This article discusses mental health challenges common in the tech industry, including impostor syndrome, based on the author's personal experience and reader feedback from a previous post. It is a soft, wellness-oriented piece rather than anything technical about tools, code, or systems. While workplace mental health is a legitimate topic, it does not fit a digest focused on technical interest for software engineers. It may have value in a different context but ranks low here.
